title: From discarded to desired: valorization of Zn–C battery waste into crystalline ZnO nanoparticles with crystallographic insights and antibacterial efficacy
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,38454-38469
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06684K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Mashrafi Bin Mobarak, Md Sohag Hossain, Fariha Chowdhury, Nourin Tarannum, Monira Binte Mesbah, Nazmul Islam Tanvir, Umme Sarmeen Akhtar, Samina Ahmed
A sustainable waste-to-wealth approach converted Zn shells from used Zn–C dry cells into wurtzite ZnO nanoparticles. Comprehensive characterization verified their purity, crystallinity, and notable antibacterial efficacy against Gram-positive bacteria.
